powers: For your combat check, you may recharge a card to use your Dexterity skill + 1d8 and add the Magic trait and the Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing trait. (☐ If you succeed at the check, you may draw a card.)

On your check to defeat (☐ or your check to acquire an item or a spell), you may recharge any number of items to add 1d4 for each item recharged (☐ plus the items' highest adventure deck number) to your check.

roles.name: Gravewalker
powers: For your combat check, you may recharge a card to use your Dexterity skill + 1d8 (☐ 2d8) and add the Magic trait and the Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing trait. (☐ If you succeed at the check, you may draw a card.)

On your check to defeat (☐ or your check to acquire an item or a spell), you may recharge any number of items to add 1d4 for each item recharges (☐ plus the items' highest adventure deck number) to your check. (☐ If the check invokes the Undead trait, add 1d6 for each item instead of 1d4.)
☐ On your check that invokes the Undead (☐ or Cold, Mental, or Poison) trait, you may discard (☐ or recharge) a spell to reroll the dice; take the new result.
☐ You may treat non-villain monsters you defeat as if they have the Undead trait.
☐ You may banish a monster displayed next to your cohort to reduce damage deal to you to 0 (☐ or to examine your location).

roles.name: Night-Haired Witch
powers: For your combat check, you may recharge a card to use your Dexterity skill + 1d8 (☐ 2d8) and add the Magic trait and the Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing trait. (☐ If you succeed at the check, you may draw a card.)

☐ On your Dexterity check, you may discard a spell to reroll the dice; take the new result.
☐ You may discard a spell or item to reduce Combat damage (☐ or any damage) dealt to you to 0.
